title: Edmund and the Regiment
author: Theo Joubert
blurb: Sable Lockridge, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
